details.callToWorship: God Moves in a Mysterious Way #073
details.fellowshipSong: Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus #485

list: Women on Mission will meet Monday, October 12 at 6:00 PM in the Lewis Fellowship Hall to put together the Christmas Shoeboxes. Sylvia Robinson and Lisa Thomas will provide the food. All women are encouraged and invited to attend.
Sunday, October 18 is the last day to turn in the questionnaire for the pastoral search committee. You can drop yours in the box in the foyer.
Our church picnic is Sunday, October 25 at 5:00 PM at Mark and Anne Deaton’s garage. They will provide soup and grilled cheese sandwiches. Please bring your favorite dessert.

fighterVerse.text: … My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
